title: Design System: NoticeGuard

source.fonts: static/fonts/ (Source Serif 4 variable, OFL 1.1; see static/fonts/LICENSE.txt)

display.purpose: Verdict heading in the slab; second clause italic 400; 2.2rem under 1400px, 1.8rem under 640px.

headline.purpose: Section h2; panel h2 at 1.2rem; wordmark at 1.55rem.

title.purpose: h3, rail stage names (1.15rem), route titles (1.1rem), rule ids.

quote.purpose: The statement block and any quoted clause; italic serif is the quotation register.

body.purpose: Default UI text, forms, tables (13.5px), chips (12px).

label.purpose: Chain step labels (uppercase, .08em), table headers (12px, .04em), 'You are here' marker (.06em).

caption.purpose: Ledes, captions, sources, slab meta, footer.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Lifted: verdict slab, draft slab, benchmark dialog, primary button hover (with translateY(-1px)).

shadows.name: btn-inset
shadows.purpose: Top bevel on the primary button at rest.

shadows.name: sentence-halo
shadows.purpose: Hover/active fill extended 4px around clickable inline sentences; Paper 2 hover, #E8E1D2 active, Slab 2 / #2E2B26 in the draft.

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Text inputs, selects, textareas on focus.

shadows.name: route-active
shadows.purpose: Active route card, with a 1px ink border.

shadows.name: stage-current
shadows.purpose: Current stage dot on the process rail.

shadows.name: mark-pulse
shadows.purpose: One-shot 900ms pulse on the highlighted quote.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for every transition and keyframe.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Buttons, inputs, sentence halos, row hovers, dropzone.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: Verdict slab and diff banner settle (scale 1.015->1, blur 3px->0, opacity .6->1).

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Accent ring on the highlighted quote.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: Skeleton bars while a result loads: a flat paper-2 bar that breathes; no gradient.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Zero durations and drop the settle.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Side columns narrow to 290 / 360px; display drops to 2.2rem.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Single column; sticky columns release; rail becomes two columns without its track.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: 16px gutters; rail one column; slabs 14px radius; footer disclaimer clamps behind a 'more' pill.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink pill with cream text; lifts 1px with the Lifted shadow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1A1917); background: var(--ink, #1A1917); color: var(--cream, #F3F0EA); border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 18px; font: 500 14px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08) inset; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 160ms, color 160ms, border-color 160ms; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(26,25,23,.28), 0 2px 6px rgba(26,25,23,.08); background: #000; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(26,25,23,.06), 0 2px 8px rgba(26,25,23,.06); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #1A1917); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: progress; transform: none; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline pill; inverts to ink on hover. Used for Load Maya / Load Leo.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline pill that firms to an ink border on Paper 2; no lift.

components.name: Segmented Control

narrative.northStar: The Case File on a Desk
narrative.overview:
NoticeGuard reads like a legal case file laid open on warm paper: one continuous cream surface, a dark charcoal verdict slab sitting on it like a bound cover, and a chain panel to the right that fills in when a sentence is clicked. There are no modals, no same-size stat cards, no transcript. Structure comes from hairlines and type, not from boxes; the only heavy objects on the page are the two charcoal slabs (verdict and draft) and the footer bar that pins the disclaimer.

Colour is disciplined to a single question: what is the verdict? Everything is ink on paper until a verdict is known, at which point one accent (green for ready, amber for gap, oxblood for adviser) appears on the slab glyph, the status chips, and the highlighted quote. Words carry the verdict; colour underlines it. The cream ground (#F3F0EA) was pinned by the user's brief, as were the serif display, charcoal rounded cards, and pill buttons; the build honours all four.

Density is that of a working tool, not a marketing page: 15px sans body, 13.5px tables, 12px chips, hairline separators at 1px, and a three-column desk that stays sticky on desktop and stacks in reading order on narrow screens.
keyCharacteristics: One warm paper surface (#F3F0EA) with 1px hairline dividers; no borders heavier than 1px anywhere.
Two charcoal slabs (verdict and draft) are the only high-contrast objects; they carry the only lifted shadow.
Exactly one accent per verdict; nothing else on the page is chromatic.
Source Serif 4 for headings, stage names, quotes, and drafted prose; system sans with tabular numerals for all UI.
Pill buttons and pill chips; rounded corners scale 8 / 14 / 22px by object weight.
Motion is short (160-320ms), exponential ease-out, and only ever responds to an action.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: `body[data-verdict]` sets `--accent` and `--accent-soft` once, page-wide, to the verdict's colour pair; before a verdict they resolve to ink and the neutral soft tint. Every chromatic element (slab glyph, status chips, document highlight, gap rule) draws from that pair or from the three fixed verdict tokens. No fourth hue exists.

rules.name: The Words First Rule
rules.body: A verdict is always a sentence plus a drawn glyph; the accent underlines it. Never signal status by colour alone (see PRODUCT.md accessibility commitment).

rules.name: The Oxblood Is Also Error Rule
rules.body: The adviser accent doubles as the error colour. Do not introduce a separate red.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks, Sans Works Rule
rules.body: Serif is reserved for what a reader would quote or read aloud: headings, stage names, clauses, the drafted statement, rule ids. Everything operational (labels, chips, tables, buttons, meta) is sans. A serif button or a sans headline is a defect.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Dates, line numbers, run counts, and deadlines align because tabular numerals are set at the body level; do not override to proportional.

rules.name: The Slabs Float, Paper Lies Flat Rule
rules.body: Only charcoal objects and a hovered primary button carry a blurred shadow. Light containers get a hairline and a lighter fill, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep every divider, border, and rule at 1px; use fill (Card, Paper 2) and ink-coloured borders for emphasis, not weight.
Do route every chromatic colour through the three verdict pairs; set `body[data-verdict]` and let `--accent` / `--accent-soft` cascade rather than hard-coding a verdict colour into a new element.
Do pair every status colour with a word and a drawn SVG glyph (the `i-check` / `i-gap` / `i-person` symbols) so the status survives without colour.
Do set headings, stage names, quotes, and drafted text in Source Serif 4 at weight 500 (400 italic for quotes) and everything operational in the system sans.
Do use the pill for buttons, chips, and segmented controls, 14px radius for sheets, 22px for charcoal slabs.
Do keep motion between 160ms and 320ms on `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)` and only in response to a user action; honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by zeroing durations.
Do honour `[hidden] { display: none !important }`: toggle the attribute, never fight it with a display rule.
Do hold the light colour scheme regardless of OS preference (`color-scheme: light` is forced); there is no dark theme.
donts: Don't add a fourth accent hue, a separate error red, or any colour on a chip, glyph, or highlight that is not one of the three verdict pairs.
Don't put a blurred shadow on a light container; only charcoal slabs and a hovered primary button lift.
Don't use emoji or icon fonts; glyphs are inline SVG symbols with `currentColor` strokes.
Don't set the wordmark, headings, or quotes in the sans, or buttons, chips, and table text in the serif.

Don't introduce modals, same-size stat cards, or a chat transcript into the tool surface; the desk is one continuous page (the benchmark page's native `<dialog>` for raw JSON is the only overlay and stays there).
Don't use gradients anywhere; even the loading skeleton is a flat paper-2 bar with an opacity pulse.

notCanonized: --cream duplicates --paper (#F3F0EA); kept as two tokens because they serve different grounds.
